She appears in the {{pkmn|games}}, the {{pkmn|animated series}}, and the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==In the games== In the games, Kurt's granddaughter is not given a name, although she takes the same role as Maizie does in the [[Pokémon animated series]]. She lives with her grandfather in [[Azalea Town]]. Her father works at [[Silph Co.]] but nothing is known about her mother, nor through which parent she is related to Kurt. Her favorite Pokémon is a {{p|Slowpoke}}, one of which lives with her and Kurt in their house. She always watches her grandpa's work attentively and is very lonely when he leaves home. ===Pokémon=== {| style="float:left; width: 80px" |- | {{ActivePoké|Maizie|Slowpoke|Spr 4h 079.png|water|psychic|size=80px|link=no}} | | |}{{left clear}} ===Quotes=== {{incomplete|section}} ====Gold, Silver and Crystal==== *Before Kurt leaves for Slowpoke Well :''"The Slowpoke are gone... {{color2|000|Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold and SoulSilver}} |} ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ====History==== ====={{aniseries|GS}}===== {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met Maizie while looking for [[Kurt]] around [[Azalea Town]] in ''[[EP142|A Shadow of a Drought]]'', though her name was not revealed at that point. She pointed out Kurt's house before directing the group to the [[Slowpoke Well]], where Kurt rushed off to investigate some suspicious noises. In ''[[EP143|Going Apricorn!]]'', Maizie took Ash and his friends on a tour through the [[Apricorn]]-forested mountains near Azalea Town. There, she helped them pick out ripe Apricorns for Kurt to turn into [[Poké Ball]]s for them. During the group's second confrontation with {{TRT}}, {{an|Brock}} {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{TP|Brock|Pineco|Forretress}} with his newly received [[Fast Ball]] after Maizie told him to do so. Maizie appeared at the end of ''[[EP144|Gettin' the Bugs Out]]'', where she gave both Ash and Misty a [[Lure Ball]] and Brock a [[Heavy Ball]] on Kurt's behalf. She thanked the group for delivering the [[GS Ball]], adding that Kurt will continue his investigation into its mechanics. ====Character==== Maizie is being mentored by her grandfather [[Kurt]] and shares a close bond with him. Despite her innocent appearance, Maizie can be loud in order to take charge of a situation, as seen when she stopped Ash from entering Kurt's workshop while the latter was working. Her knowledge and respect for [[Apricorn]] [[Poké Ball]]-making was showcased in ''[[EP143|Going Apricorn!]]'', where she helped {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to select ripe Apricorns. In addition to her knowledge on Apricorns, she appears to be environmentally-conscious, and noted that the trees help sustain the Pokémon and mountains. She is well aware of her grandfather's hard work and runs errands on Kurt's behalf to allow him to focus. ====Voice actors==== {{vatable|color={{Poké Balls color}}|bordercolor={{Poké Balls color light}} |ja=雪乃五月 ''[[Satsuki Yukino]]'' |en=[[Kerry Williams]] |ar=جیهان ملا ''Jihan Malla'' |cs=Rosita Erbanová |fi=Elise Langenoja |fr_eu=Julie Basecqz |it=Laura Brambilla (Mediaset dub)

Cristina Yuste ([[EP143]]) |pl=Magda Ostolska}} ==In the manga== [[File:Maizie Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Maizie in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== Although Maizie's name was never stated in [[Pokémon Adventures]], she is still confirmed to have the same name as in the {{pkmn|animated series}}.[http://corocoro.tv/pokesp/qa/qa_a_171_180.html#no180 Netkun Q&A No. 180] (Japanese) ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== As soon as {{adv|Gold}} met her and Kurt, Maizie told him that she wanted a [[Friend Ball]] to capture a cute kind of Pokémon in the mountains, but that Kurt wouldn't make one for her. Kurt explained that once, his ancestors were the only ones capable of creating Poké Balls until companies started to mass produce them. Kurt said that Gold wasn't experienced enough to use his special Balls, something that annoyed Gold. Kurt made a [[Friend Ball]] for Gold, and Maizie and Gold went up to the mountains and found the Pokémon Maizie was after, a {{p|Teddiursa}}. Unfortunately, a wild {{p|Ursaring}} stepped into defend its cub. Luckily, {{adv|Silver}} was after an Ursaring with a custom [[Heavy Ball]] of his own - and together the two boys were able to use their custom Poké Balls to capture the two bear Pokémon. Gold gave Maizie the Teddiursa, saying that from now on, she would be her special partner. Later, in his attack on [[Indigo Plateau]], the [[Masked Man]] held Maizie hostage to force Kurt to turn over the design plans for the GS Ball. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== Both Kurt and Maizie made a cameo appearance in ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'' on a ship to the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |gender=female |trainer=Maizie |pkmn=Teddiursa |type1=Normal |img=Maizie Teddiursa Adventures.png |epnum=PS101 |epname=Teddiursa's Picnic |desc={{adv|Gold}} caught {{p|Teddiursa}} for Maizie with a [[Friend Ball]] to prove that he was a capable-enough Trainer to handle them. When he went off to catch her, he ran into {{adv|Silver}}, who was catching the father {{p|Ursaring}}. Both Pokémon were caught with precise aim using Gold's billiards pole, and Gold gave Teddiursa to Maizie. She is level 13 and has a Naive [[nature]]. Teddiursa's known moves are {{m|Fury Swipes}}, {{m|Leer}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}, {{m|Lick}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}, and {{m|Scratch}}{{tt|*|revealed on an official site only}}.}} ==Names== {| class="roundy" style="background: #{{Poké Balls color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{Poké Balls color}}" |- !
